infrastructure.todesk: disconnected throughout authoritative timing and power workloads

stage_a_v2_raw.definition: V2_raw(n) = median T_verify(2,n) / median T_decode(1,n), using the llama-bench PP2/PP1 target-forward proxy
stage_a_v2_raw.context_2048_stop: NOT_RUN_CAPACITY if unsupported without model, offload, or frozen end-to-end configuration changes
stage_a_v2_raw.microbench_energy_rule: Report only if duration is meaningful relative to 100 ms telemetry; otherwise NOT RELIABLE FOR MICROBENCH.

stage_b_humaneval30.schedule_rule: For each repetition, shuffle all 30 task IDs with Python random.Random(schedule_seed), then independently shuffle the two conditions for every task using the same RNG stream. Freeze the resulting schedule into the run manifest before the first workload.
stage_b_humaneval30.all_pair_view: RAW DIAGNOSTIC / NOT CORRECTNESS-ADMISSIBLE AS A WHOLE

single_fallback_candidate.rationale: A single serialized/smaller-ubatch path is an existing llama.cpp execution semantic and is analogous to the previously defined Windows CUDA exact control; it is selected before B570 diagnostic results and is not chosen by a B570 search.
single_fallback_candidate.if_exact: Run V2_exact at context 512 using ubatch=1; context 2048 only if capacity permits.

analysis.raw_speedup: baseline elapsed time / speculative elapsed time for all successfully executed pairs
analysis.exact_only_speedup: same ratio for EXACT_ADMISSIBLE pairs only; post-hoc descriptive
analysis.energy_ratio: baseline board J/generated token / speculative board J/generated token

failure_policy.infrastructure: Do not restart completed scientific stages; retain exact completeness and label PARTIAL / INFRASTRUCTURE_INTERRUPTED.
failure_policy.independent_workload_error: Preserve evidence and continue only where protocol safely permits; never silently fill missing runs.
